items.text: PLA/PHA is a tougher and less brittle material than the generic PLA grades, thanks to the addition of Polyhydroxy Alkenoate (PHA).
PHA is a bio-polyester, produces by fermentation processes within bacteria, is also 100% biodegradable, leading to a more eco-friendly filament.
The added PHA makes our grade of PLA tougher and less brittle than generic PLA grades in the market.
PHA (polyhydroxyalkanoate) is like PLA a bio-polyester, so our unique blend is still 100% biodegradeable.
The rough surface of the tape will provide sufficient adhesion for the first layer to stick, and print with limited to no warping.
The rough surface of the tape will provide enough adhesion for the first layer to stick and print almost without any warping.
The PLA/PHA performs amply on both heated and non-heated build platforms.
When working on a cold build platform, it is advised to use masking tape to the area.
Our PLA/PHA performs well on both heated and non-heated build platforms.
For those users printing on a cold build platform we advise applying masking tape to the build area.
